items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: you didn't play Red Whitney, call that player.

ctx.x: What did they do then? You mentioned that the way you used to vamp. Did Duesen do that way or how did he?

Yeah, he used to play, you didn't play Red Whitney, call that player. You would look like you was a, you just play all for him. Because your music was written that way. It wasn't, sometimes you catch a portion in there as a soloist like, but then it dropped back, you know, while you playing all for him with a different melody all together. Did you say like a harmony part?
